LESSON: KUANDIKA 15.3.1 BARUAPEPE YA KIOFISI

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.3: Kuandika 15.3.1 Baruapepe ya Kiofisi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 15.3.1 Baruapepe ya Kiofisi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki baruapepe ya kiofisi
2. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya baruapepe ya kiofisi
3. kutumia lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa baruapepe ya kiofisi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki baruapepe ya kiofisi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki baruapepe ya kiofisi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya baruapepe ya kiofisi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya baruapepe ya kiofisi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa baruapepe ya kiofisi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa baruapepe ya kiofisi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 15.3.1 Baruapepe ya Kiofisi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 15.3.1 Baruapepe ya Kiofisi in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 15.3.1 Baruapepe ya Kiofisi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 15.3.1 Baruapepe ya Kiofisi.
4. Show that you can: kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki baruapepe ya kiofisi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 15.3.1 Baruapepe ya Kiofisi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 15.3.1 Baruapepe ya Kiofisi important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki baruapepe ya kiofisi
2. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya baruapepe ya kiofisi
3. kutumia lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa baruapepe ya kiofisi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
